paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, hichi in achi:
heading: Pathian In Israel Akepna
english: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, Jerusalem zak in kikou in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Na tuailai a na migitdante, kikham lai a na hon itdante ka theigige hi; gamdai a khoh louh gam a na hon zuihdan bang.
english: “Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, the love of your weddings; how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

paite: Israel bel TOUPA a dia hihsiangthou, agahpung masa ahi, amah negaimi peuhmah amoh ding a, atung uah siatna ahong tung ding,’ " chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him shall be held guilty. Evil shall come on them,”’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Aw Jakob inkote leh Israel inkote tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un;
heading: Israel Suangtute Khelhna
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na pipute un kei ah diktatlouhna bang ahia amuh uh, kei a kipan gamlapi ah avakmang ua, bangmah loul delh a, ana ki-otsak uh?
english: Thus says Yahweh, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

paite: 'TOUPA, Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhia a, gamdai, gamkeu, kokhuk mun, sihna limliap leh gamkeu mun, kuamah paisuak ngeilouhna, kuamah omlouhna mun a hon pi paisuakpa koi a om ahia? achi kei uh.
english: Neither did they say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that none passed through, and where no man lived?’

paite: Gam hoihtak ah, agah leh hoihna ne ding in, ka hon pilut a, himahleh na lut uleh ka gam na hihnin ua, ka goutan thilkihhuai in na bawl uh.
english: I brought you into a plentiful land, to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

paite: Siampute'n, 'TOUPA koi a om ahia?' achi kei ua, Dan zang mite'n ahon thei sam kei uh, vaihawmte ka tung ah ahel ua, zawlneite'n Baal min in thu agen ua, thil phatuam lou dingte adelh uh."
english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

paite: "Huchi in ka hon langbawl ding a, na tate uh ta nawnte leng ka langbawl lailai ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
heading: Amite Toh Kal A TOUPA Thubuai
english: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

paite: Kittim tuikulh ah va hoh unla, en un, Kedar ah mi sawl unla, chiktak in ngaihtuah un, hichibang thil a-om ngeina hiam chih theihna ding in.
english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see; and send to Kedar, and consider diligently; and see if there has been such a thing.

paite: Namte'n apathian uh akheng uhia, pathiantak hiloupi leng? Ka mite'n bel athupina uh, thil phatuam loutak in akhek uh.
english: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.

paite: "Aw vante, lamdang sa unla, hon mulkimsak henla, mau tuaituai un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ka mite'n thil nih ahihkhial uhi: kei, hinna tuikhuk ahon paisan ua, tui ching thei lou ding tuivungte atoukhia uhi.
english: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

paite: Israel sikha ahi hia? Sikha mawng a piang hia? Bangziak a nuaisiah a om ahia?
heading: Israel Muanhuai Louhna Gahte
english: Is Israel a servant? Is he a native-born slave? Why has he become a prey?

paite: Humpinelkai tuailaite'n hamkhum in, atung ah aw asuah ua, agam ahihgawp khinta uh, akhopite leng luahmi nei lou in akangsiang khin hi.
english: The young lions have roared at him, and yelled. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

paite: Memphis mi leh Tahpanhes mite'n, na luzang agiausak khinta uh.
english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in lampi a ahon pi lai a, na taimangsan ziak in, huai na tung a na tunsak ahi kei maw?
english: “Haven’t you procured this to yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , when he led you by the way?

paite: Nile tui dawn ding a Aigupta lampi na zuih, nang ding a bang aphatuam a? Luipi tui dawn ding a Assuria lampi na zuih, nang ding in bang aphatuam a?
english: Now what have you to do in the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or what have you to do in the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

paite: Na thulimlouhna in hon thuaksak ding a, na nungkinna in nang ahon sal ding hi; hon launa nei lou TOUPA na Pathian na paisan a, thil giloutak leh kha mahmah ahi na hih, na theikhia inla, mu telta in, chih, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Your own wickedness shall correct you, and your backsliding shall reprove you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and a bitter, that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Nidanglai a pan na hakkol hihtan in, na khaute leng na hihtatta hi, 'Na nna ka sem nawn kei ding,' na chi a, mual sangte, singbawk nuai ah na kizuak hi.
heading: Israel In TOUPA Biak Ding Anial
english: “For of old time I have broken your yoke, and burst your bonds; and you said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

paite: Chi dik zang in grepgui hoih mahmah ka hon phut a, bangchidan a kikheng a, kei a dia grep tak lou hong suakta na hia?
english: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, wholly a right seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

paite: Tangal in kisil in sahbon tampi zang mah lechin, na thulimlouhna ka mitmuh in adawk teitei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: 'Ka kihihnin sam a, Baalte ka delh sam a, bang achia chi thei na hia, phaizang kuak a na omdante en inla, na thilhihsate thei in; sangawngsaula huk diang ngongngong na hi vele.
english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

paite: Gam sabiltung gamdai a om, ahuk lai a dak uau-uau a dik vutvut bang; a-utna kua'n ahia dalzou ding? Azongmi kihihgim nuam dah hen, ahun in amu na ding uh.
english: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that snuffs up the wind in her desire. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.

paite: Na khe ah khedap bun lou in om ke'nla, na dang leng hul kei heh; nang bel, lamet abeita, pau tuam mite ka ngai a, amau ka delh ding,' na chi hi.
english: “Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

paite: "Guta aphawk ua azum bang in, Israel inkote azumta uh, amau, akumpipate uh, aheutute uh, asiampute uh, azawlneite uh leng.
heading: Israel Gawt Tak Him Ahi
english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets;

paite: Singbul kiang a, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi a, suangbul kiang a, 'Kei hon suangtu na hi,' chi mite; masuan lou in adekkhuk sah uh ahon suan zaw ua, amangbat hun un bel, 'Thou in, hon hondam tanla,' achi ding uh, na pathian, huai na bawlte koi a om ahita ua?
english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father;’ and a stone, ‘You have brought me out:’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us.’

paite: "Amau thou zaw uhenla, na mangbat lai in ahon hondam thei khamoh ding uhia; aw Judah, na pathiante bel na khopite zah mah ahi ve ua oi!
english: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble: for according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah.

paite: Bangziak a ka tung a vui nak? Na vek un ka tung ah thil na hihkhial ngal ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Na tate uh ka khen a, aphatuam kei, ahoih loh tuan kei uh; humpinelkai duhgawl bang mai in, noumau namsau in na zawlneite uh ane khin uhi.
english: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

paite: Aw khangthakte aw, TOUPA thu thei un, Israel a ding in gamdai gam bang ka hi maw? Mial sah meuhmouh gam ka hi maw? Ka mite'n bangdia, ka pawt kichianta ua, ka hong kik nawn kei ding uh, chi uh ahia?
english: Generation, consider the word of Yahweh. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more?’

paite: Nungak siangthou in akizephoihnate amangngilh thei in, mouthak in akivatna amangngilh thei ding maw? Ka mite'n ni sim seng louh sung in ahon na mangngilhta uhi.
english: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

paite: Deihtakmi muhtheihna ding in na omdan ngentel na chia! Numei gilou kiang ah leng na omdan na sinsakta ve.
english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have taught even the wicked women your ways.

paite: Na nikte ah leng migenthei poi khoihloute hinna sisan alang a; na inn abuluh lai khutmat ahi kei uhi.
english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You did not find them breaking in; but it is because of all these things.

paite: "Ka moh kei a, kei a kipan ahehna lakmang ahi, na chi nawn ngal a, ngai in, 'Ka gilou kei hi,' na chih ziak in, na tungthu ka ngaihtuah ding.
english: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

paite: Na omdan kheng mengmeng a, bangziak a vialvak vak na hia? Assuria na zumpih mah bang in, Aigupta leng na zumpih lai ding hi.
english: Why do you go about so much to change your way? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

paite: Na khutte lukhuk in akiang ua pan na pawtkhe nawn dia, TOUPA'N lah na muannate apaikheta ngal a, amau ah na lamzang kei ding hi."
english: From there also you shall go forth, with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you shall not prosper with them.
